name: xcode-overlay-service
goal: Recognize only the selected signed Xcode overlay service after verified system adoption; preserve refusal of lookalikes and unproven leftovers.

steps.title: Identify the regression, prior working behavior, root cause, and evidence.
steps.evidence: The real immutable native build passed all six assertions but failed cleanup because an Interface Builder overlay child outlived ibtoold. The selected Xcode signs this exact service as com.apple.InterfaceBuilder.IBAgent-iOS; the policy currently recognizes only ibtoold.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the regression; name the coverage gap and reusable test or shared guard change.
steps.evidence: The standard signed-service matrix covers one service path only. Extend its same adopted, wrong-identity, lookalike and installed-authority assertions to the overlay service while preserving all refusal controls.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: Committed db6b9f92b; sealed red afedac467 reproduces four actual policy assertions, including private instead of delegated, with the existing settlement controls retained. An earlier assertion description did not match output and was rejected rather than accepted as proof.

steps.title: Propose a root-cause repair and an automated guard for the identified failure.
steps.evidence: Add only the canonical selected-Xcode IBAgent-iOS path and Apple signature to the vetted set; guard its name from signalling elsewhere. Keep signature, process identity, detached group and launchd-adoption checks unchanged.

steps.title: Implement the repair and wire the prevention test or guard into normal project verification.
steps.evidence: c6b5f84c registers only the exact IBAgent-iOS overlay path and Apple identity under the selected canonical Xcode. Guarded names protect lookalikes without accepting them. All 15 standard service/cleanup tests and root types, full lint and audit pass.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: Frozen same-environment red 3a11e5c4 at db6b9f92b reproduces the private-instead-of-delegated defect; paired green e64b2910 at c6b5f84c passes identical tests and fixture inputs. A separately launched green was rejected for environment mismatch and is not proof.

steps.title: In an isolated fixture or temporary workspace, prove reintroducing the original failure makes the guard fail; restore and prove it passes.
steps.evidence: The isolated original-policy snapshot rejects the expanded standard matrix; restored exact-service policy passes all 15 cases with wrong-signature, lookalike, unadopted and ordinary-private cleanup controls intact. A real native snapshot rerun is pending, so final verification remains open.

steps.title: Repeat until the guard and relevant project checks pass; verify affected UI flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending while proof fails.
